verdict.rationale: Svelte provides built-in reactive primitives ($state, $derived, $effect) that work across .svelte.js/.svelte.ts files to share reactive state app-wide without any external state library, and community feedback confirms Svelte's stores/context system is 'especially great for sharing state.' missing for 10: no dedicated docs example specifically framed as 'global store' pattern in this pack, and no independent benchmark/comparison against third-party state libs.
